description: Storage-tree fixtures for STO-01 (build/browse) and STO-02 (atomic move). Includes an eight-level subtree and explicit cross-root move cases. Node keys are stable placeholders; loaders map them to immutable UUID public IDs and lowercase UUID-hex ltree labels. Rename changes display data only and never rewrites storage_nodes.path.

notes.eightLevelSubtree: warehouse-a -> a-l1 -> ... -> a-l8 is a nine-node chain whose deepest node sits at depth 8, satisfying the eight-level subtree requirement in blueprint sections 20.3 and HND-03.
notes.privacy: Exact path is private by default (STO-01); public breadcrumb behavior is validated separately.

moveCases.name: cross-root-move
moveCases.description: Move a subtree from Warehouse A into Warehouse B. path, depth, and tree_root_id must update for every descendant (STO-02).

moveCases.name: reject-own-descendant
moveCases.description: Moving a node into one of its own descendants must be rejected before any subtree mutation (STO-02 acceptance criteria).

moveCases.name: reject-archived-target
moveCases.description: Moving into an archived or missing target rolls back without partial updates.

moveCases.name: opposing-concurrent-moves
moveCases.description: Two opposing moves must serialize on deterministic row/root locks and leave a valid acyclic connected tree (STO-02).
